summary: One tooltip panel that follows the cursor, shown from anywhere.
overview: Add one to your Canvas, assign the panel and text, then call Show from anywhere — or just add a trigger to individual elements for zero-code hover tooltips.
useCases: Hover descriptions on items and abilities.
Explaining a setting without cluttering the screen.
Contextual help on an editor-style UI.

params.tuning: In screen pixels. Enough that the cursor does not sit on top of the text, and not so much that the tooltip drifts off screen at the edges.

gotchas.title: It does not keep itself on screen
gotchas.body: Near a screen edge the panel can extend past it. Clamping is not built in.
